feeding_claim.verbatim: We are a 100% forage based system. Our animals have been born and raised on grass on our farm. We do not grain finish.

availability.note: Waitlist for 2026 beef shares is open; the farm aims to fill requests within a year.

notes: Sells whole and half beef shares by waitlist and deposit, processed at Potts Family Meats in Jefferson, GA. The site does not say how buyers collect the beef (pickup or delivery), so sales_channels left empty for the Verifier. Phone is written out in words on the site.
